name: 55 MA
summary: This EA uses a 55-period Moving Average as its core indicator to identify and follow market trends. It opens buy positions when price crosses above the 55 MA and sell positions when price crosses below, riding the trend until a reversal signal occurs. The strategy is a classic trend-following system based on the well-known 55-period MA popularized by turtle trading methods.
summary_zh: 该EA使用55周期移动平均线作为核心指标来识别和跟踪市场趋势。当价格上穿55均线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，顺势持仓直到反转信号出现。这是一个基于著名的海龟交易法55均线的经典趋势跟踪系统。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于55周期移动平均线趋势跟踪，属于经典的单均线突破系统。入场条件为价格从下方突破55均线时做多，从上方跌破55均线时做空，属于典型的趋势跟随入场方式。出场条件依赖于均线的反向穿越信号，即持有多单时价格跌破均线则平仓，持有空单时价格突破均线则平仓。仓位管理方面，从文件名推断可能采用固定手数或基于ATR的波动性仓位计算方式。资金管理上，单均线系统通常缺乏完善的风险控制机制，容易在震荡市中产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现优异，但在横盘整理期间会遭受多次止损磨损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the 55-period Moving Average trend following, which is a classic single-MA breakout system. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price crosses above the 55 MA from below and a sell when price crosses below from above, representing a typical trend-following entry approach. Exit conditions rely on the reverse crossover signal of the MA - closing longs when price breaks below the MA and closing shorts when price breaks above it. Position sizing may employ fixed lot sizes or ATR-based volatility-adjusted position calculation based on common implementations of this type. Money management in single-MA systems typically lacks comprehensive risk controls, making it susceptible to frequent false signals during ranging markets that lead to consecutive losses. The strategy excels in strongly trending markets but suffers from whipsaw losses during sideways consolidation periods.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
55均线是经过长期验证的趋势跟踪参数，具有统计学意义
在强趋势市场中能捕捉大段利润，盈亏比优秀
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
The 55-period MA is a well-validated trend following parameter with statistical significance
Capable of capturing large trend moves in strong trending markets with excellent risk-reward ratio
cons: 单均线系统在震荡市中频繁产生假信号，造成连续亏损
缺乏过滤机制来区分趋势市和震荡市
没有明确的止损止盈设置，风险控制不足
cons_en: Single MA system generates frequent false signals in ranging markets causing consecutive losses
Lacks filtering mechanism to distinguish between trending and ranging market conditions
No explicit stop-loss and take-profit settings, resulting in insufficient risk control
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器如ADX或多时间框架确认来减少震荡市假信号
加入ATR动态止损止盈以适应市场波动性变化
增加仓位管理模块，根据账户风险比例动态调整手数
improvements_en: Add trend filter such as ADX or multi-timeframe confirmation to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to market volatility changes
Add position sizing module that dynamically adjusts lot size based on account risk percentage

risk_points: 单均线系统在横盘市场中会产生频繁的虚假交易信号
缺乏硬性止损保护，极端行情下可能造成大幅亏损
没有新K线检查机制，可能导致同一信号重复开仓
risk_points_en: Single MA system generates frequent false trading signals in sideways markets
Lack of hard stop-loss protection may cause significant losses during extreme market moves
No new bar check mechanism may lead to repeated position opening on the same signal
